- **rule** `blocks/delete-nothing-can-reach-never-repair`: Delete a `BuildingBlock` nothing can reach; never repair one, and never add a second implementation of playout logic beside an existing one. A countdown wanted here again is `templates/shared/clock.ts`'s deadline runtime, not a second copy of the idea. Reachability is whatever `src/ai/stubProvider.ts` actually passes to `block(...)`, so read that file before calling an entry dead.
- **rule** `blocks/position-inserted-element-lower-left-action`: Position an inserted element with `positionForNewElement` in the lower-left action-safe area, tag it `data-gfx` and style it with `textCssRule`. A block groups under a hierarchical `path` and names the `primaryTab` to reveal after applying. Animation blocks come in two tracks: CSS (`@keyframes` plus a class on the element) and GSAP (a tween injected into `play()`/`stop()`).
